ground_truth.root_cause_entity: CBS (Component Based Servicing) - backup log cab creation subroutine
ground_truth.root_cause_type: Backup log cabinet creation failure (HRESULT 0x80070001 - ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION) during TrustedInstaller servicing/scavenge cycle
ground_truth.recommended_action: Investigate why CBS's cab-creation call returns ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION during the backup/scavenge phase — check for corrupted or version-mismatched compression libraries (e.g. cabinet.dll), insufficient permissions on the servicing backup directory, or a pending reboot blocking the operation. Since it recurs on a later servicing session (2016-09-29 00:03:25), a manual System File Checker (sfc /scannow) and DISM /RestoreHealth pass is recommended to validate the component store integrity, and monitor whether it prevents future backups needed for rollback support.
